• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese, nonché la capacità di interagire con diversi stakeholder

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Project Manager in business die casting, you can help shape the future of a key industry technology – by taking responsibility for international, highly automated plant projects from the first offer and concept phase to the successful customer handover and experience how innovative ideas become powerful solutions for our customers on a daily basis. Tasks:
• You are responsible for the management and handling of international plant projects in the field of die casting - from the offer and concept phase to planning and customer handover - with a high degree of automation
• You will take over the technical leadership of the project team including resource deployment planning
• You take over the project analysis, problem identification and correction as well as the initiation of measures
• You are responsible for the implementation of basic and detailed engineering involving internal and external stakeholders
• They enjoy regular contact with customers and various internal and external stakeholders and support the offer Requirements
• Technical studies in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering (FH/HF) or similar
• Experience in handling international investment projects
• Knowledge of automation and electrical planning
• Very good communication skills in German and English as well as ability to interact with different stakeholders
• Independent, motivated and resilient personality, which is open for international travel (about 20%) We offer: Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Employer-funded pension plan Bühler Pensionskasse offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Buhler Group in Izmir, Türkiye, is looking for a skilled and proactive professional to join our Service Operations Team as a Project Operations Lead. The role will be responsible to coordinate and monitor active Service and Plant Projects, ensuring alignment across engineering, customers, local teams along with driving milestone execution, issue resolution, and successful installation and commissioning activities. The role requires a strong commitment to quality, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, and compliance with Bühler directives and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards.

Aufgaben:
• Coordinate and monitor all active Service and Plant Projects within the local organization.

• Act as the primary interface between customers, Service Project Engineers, local teams, and global Bühler project organizations.

• Guide Service Project Engineers and support engineering alignment during project planning and execution.

• Track project milestones, risks, deviations, and execution progress, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of critical issues.

• Support global Project Managers by coordinating local resources, site readiness, stakeholder communication, installation, and commissioning activities.

• Facilitate collaboration between customer sites, engineering functions, service teams, and global stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with Bühler directives, processes, and EHS standards.

• Maintain project reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities, including lessons learned and service solution planning.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

• Minimum 7 years of experience in project coordination, service operations, or industrial engineering environments.

• Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional teams.

• Strong technical understanding across engineering and process disciplines, with the ability to translate complexity into effective execution and coordination.

• Fluent in English and Turkish (written and spoken).

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to travel and work flexible hours when required.

• Residing in the Izmir or Manisa region.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler (China) Investment Co., Ltd. established in 2011 in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, is the group headquarters of the Swiss Bühler Group in Greater China and the first integrated headquarters of multinational companies in Jiangsu Province. With our advanced technology, we lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and die-casting, grinding and dispersion. With our vision of "Innovations for a better world", we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization.
布勒（中国）投资有限公司，于2011年在江苏无锡成立，是瑞士布勒集团在大中华区设立的集团总部，也是江苏省首批跨国公司综合性总部。我们凭借先进的技术优势，在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造、及压铸、研磨与分散等领域引领市场。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案。 Aufgaben: • Drive lead generation programs to fuel business growth across China region.驱动销售线索生成项目，助力大中华区业务增长。 • Plan, execute, and optimize digital campaigns to boost engagement and conversion rates.策划、执行并优化数字营销活动，提升用户参与度与转化率。 • Monitor digital marketing campaign performance, analyze ROI, and recommend data-driven improvements.监测数字营销活动KPI，分析投资回报率，并提出数据驱动的优化建议。 • Analyze official website, social medias and all digital platform data to extract actionable business insights.分析官方网站，社交媒体平台及所有数字平台数据，提炼可执行的商业洞察。 • Build and maintain real-time dashboards for performance tracking and executive reporting.搭建并维护实时数据看板，支持绩效追踪与管理汇报。 • Manage daily website operations, including content updates, user experience optimization, and technical coordination.负责网站日常运营与管理，包括内容更新、用户体验优化及技术协调。 • Improve website traffic quality, lead scoring accuracy, and end-to-end conversion performance.提升网站流量质量、线索评分精准度及全链路转化表现。 • Support SEO/GEO strategy implementation and related martech tool development.支持搜索引擎优化/生成式引擎优化策略落地及相关营销技术工具开发。 • Coordinate with business units, global corporate communication and related department, and external agencies on digital marketing projects & initiatives.协调业务部门、全球企业传播团队和相关部门及外部供应商，推进数字营销项目与活动。 • Provide cross-functional support to ensure seamless execution of digital programs.提供跨职能支持，确保数字项目顺畅执行。 • Liaise with internal stakeholders and external partners to align digital capabilities with business priorities.对接内部利益相关者及外部合作伙伴，确保数字能力与业务优先级对齐。 Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Business, Data Analytics, or related field.本科及以上学历，市场营销、商科、数据分析或相关专业。 • 5+ years of experience in B2B digital marketing, demand generation, or website & social media operations.5年以上B2B数字营销、销售线索生成或网站及社交媒体运营经验。 • Fluent in English (written and spoken).英语流利（书面及口语）。 • Proven track record in digital marketing campaign execution, website & social media management, and performance optimization.具备数字营销活动执行、网站及社交媒体管理及绩效优化的成功实践。 • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience in reporting and dashboard management.具备扎实的数据分析能力，有报告撰写及看板管理的实操经验。 • Familiarity with digital marketing platforms, analytics tools, and tracking methodologies.熟悉数字营销平台、分析工具及追踪方法。 • Experience with SEO/GEO implementation or related tools is a plus.具备SEO/GEO实施经验或相关工具使用经验者优先。 • Solid project coordination and stakeholder management skills in a matrix organization.具备矩阵式组织中的项目协调及利益相关者管理能力。 • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across regional and global teams.能够同时处理多优先级任务，并与区域及全球团队协作。 • A fast learner with a proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven mindset, adept at independent work in fast-paced, agile environments.快速学习、主动积极、注重细节，以结果为导向，能够在快速敏捷的环境中独立开展工作。 • Based in Wuxi, with flexibility for occasional travel.常驻无锡，可灵活安排偶尔出差。 Two billion people eat food every descriptionByLocale.it:
Aufgaben:
• Part of a team responsible to process single machines and small project orders in SAP from Order to Delivery for the assigned countries.
• Single point of contact on Order Commercial and Delivery matters between Project Manager and intercompany Supplier.
• Day to day process includes but not limited to:
• Create Sales Order in SAP accurately and timely.
• Issue purchase order to Suppliers and follow up Order confirmation to ensure project timeline is met.
• Close monitoring of machine readiness and ensure timely delivery and completeness of invoice.
• Data maintenance in SAP to ensure up to date information for accurate turnover forecast
• Prepare Invoices and sending it to Sales / customers.
• Co-ordinate with Sales manager / Project Manager to collect outstanding payment.
• Co-ordinate in arranging shipping documents such as Packing list and Bill of Lading (B/L) and co-ordinate with forwarder / Logistic department for shipment.
• Maintenance of documentation in SAP (softcopies of various documents in relevant folder).
• Participate in monthly project reviews with Project Manager and Project Controller.
• Work closely with Sales team and Project Execution team to handle customer's enquiries and to meet project time schedule. Provide correct and prompt response to internal and external customers enquiries professionally and timely.

• Diploma/Bachelor Degree; preferably in Business Management / Supply Chain
• Minimum 4 years Knowledge in Order Management & Logistic Process
• Working knowledge of SAP systems is a plus
• Experience in project support is an advantage
• Proficient in English, both written and spoken

• Convert business information into demand planning within the system, verify capacity across different factories, and ensure financial performance aligns with targets
• Review quotations to check lead times, consider factory workload in line with the requirements of the business
• Coordinating closely and collaborating with Commercial team, Procurement, Shipping and Manufacturing
• Define supply chain events for all components based on project strategy, lead times and given capacities
• Draft, adjust and update the event schedule and prepare event schedule for kick-off meetings
• Track major events, monitor progress and proactively define actions with the Project Manager, the Supply Chain and Logistics in case of deviation or delay
• Act as Single point of contact within the Sales & Operations Planning Process for Project Manager, Supply Chain and Logistics
• Manage and coordinate factory supplies, ensuring a balanced supply plan that aligns project priorities and factory requirements with the manufacturing planner Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's Degree in a technical field or equivalent, Master's degree in a technical field will be considered as a plus
• 1 to 2 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Management, or Project Planning
• Very good communication skills in English, any additional language will be considered as a plus
• Strong ability in the use of SAP, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Analysis) and SAP IBP
• Strong customer focused problem solving and conflict management skills
• Team spirit and well-developed communication skills as well as the ability to work within an interdisciplinary and international environment Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Provide the required engineering services including all deliveries within the time schedule, with the required quality, while ensuring compliance with Bühler related directives and EHS stand-ards. Managing of all technical interfaces with customer including specifications for sub sup-plies. Aufgaben:
• Is responsible for small projects on all technical belonging related with his specialization, approves deliverables to ensure that design will meet the customers expectation
• Support Project Managers in more complex overall projects by executing sub-systems
• Manage the allocated project in technical belongings to achieve the project goals and objectives
• Manage all relevant internal and external interfaces to suppliers, partners and clients
• Participate in Project Reviews as support of the Project Manager/ Director if required
• Arrange and lead internal and support external reviews
• Actively participate in project meetings with cross - functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers
• Support Project Manager to ensure a proper project execution according the Bühler Project Management process and provide technical support to Claim and Deviation Management
• Prepare all necessary project execution specification for purchase orders for the responsible scope of work
• Resolve questions or problems that occur during the design and manufacturing as well as during installation and commissioning
• Track schedules to ensure his parts of the projects are executed completely and on time. Prioritise and manage work hours to support budgeted hours and scheduled due dates for projects. Mitigate in engineering to ensure on time placement of purchase orders without any subsequent deliveries
• Is responsible for the assigned budget of his part of the project, including cost and quality of subcontracted design services
• Prepares the necessary documentation for the installation process
• Tracks any deviation in the scope of work in the Bühler CAQ system
• Is able to prepare work packages which can be shifted to other engineering locations
• Capture return of experience and best practice, apply lessons learned. Organizes and accomplish a debriefing meeting Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree or above, major in mechanical engineering or food science
• More than two years of working experience in machine manufacturing and/or food industry.
• Good written and oral communication skills, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company
• Industry knowledge
• Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills
• Ability to work and lead international engineering teams
• Customer focus
• Sound judgment and decision making skills
• Excellent problem solving skills
• Ability to work in a matrix organization
• Comfortable working on multiple projects at one time. Able to plan and organize work in order to meet project dates and objectives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und Wachstum. Als Teil der globalen Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden sind wir führender Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren entwickeln wir Lösungen für Architekturglas, Brillengläser sowie optische Komponenten in Smartphones, Fahrzeugen und der Medizintechnik.

Für unseren Standort Leipzig suchen wir einen motivierten Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Supply Chain. Sie planen und steuern unsere Supply Chain und tragen so zu einem reibungslosen Projektablauf bei. Wenn Sie Einsatzbereitschaft, Freundlichkeit und Freude an neuen Herausforderungen mitbringen, freuen wir uns auf Sie.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Als Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Leipziger Team und gestalten aktiv die Effizienz unserer Supply Chain mit: • Verantwortung für die Produktionsplanung und -steuerung inklusive aller Supply-Chain-Aktivitäten am Standort • Planung und Steuerung von Montage- und Fertigungsaufträgen • Pflege und Optimierung von Arbeitsplänen, Forecasts, Lageraufträgen und Mindestbeständen • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Einkauf, Produktion und Logistik • Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen und Schnittstellen in der gesamten Supply Chain • Perspektivisch Übernahme weiterer Verantwortung bis hin zur Teamleitung Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung oder Studium (idealerweise Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) • Fundierte Berufserfahrung in Supply Chain, Produktionsplanung, -steuerung oder Disposition • Idealerweise Branchenerfahrung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau sowie Kenntnisse im Supply Chain Management • Gute ERP-Kenntnisse (vorzugsweise SAP) und sehr sichere MS-Office-Kenntnisse (insbesondere Excel und Power BI von Vorteil) • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Strukturierte, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Einsatzbereitschaft Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Vielfältiger und integrativer Arbeitsplatz Wir fördern eine inklusive Kultur, die unsere globale Vielfalt wertschätzt. Respekt und Empathie sorgen dafür, dass sich alle sicher fühlen und ihr Bestes geben können. Öffentliche und private Anbindung Unser Standort bietet eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und bequeme Parkplätze, die Ihnen das tägliche Pendeln erleichtern. Learning Plattform Willkommen in einer Welt von über 16.000 Möglichkeiten, sich weiterzubilden! Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

Per il nostro laboratorio analitico stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata e curiosa per uno stage nel campo dell'analisi fisica. In questo ruolo versatile, ci supporterete nella caratterizzazione dei prodotti alimentari e dei materiali tecnici e otterrete interessanti approfondimenti sui metodi di analisi moderni come le dimensioni delle particelle, la viscosità, il colore, la texture e le analisi termiche. Essi lavorano precisamente sulla preparazione del campione, la valutazione e l'interpretazione dei risultati di misura e contribuiscono a rispondere alle domande tecnologiche. Sarete in scambio con il nostro team di laboratorio, partner interni e clienti e può contribuire le vostre abilità analitiche per progetti di sviluppo e svilupparli ulteriormente. Compiti:

• Parlano di domande e analisi con clienti, clienti e partner commerciali
• Eseguono analisi di routine come dimensioni delle particelle, viscosità, colore, texture e analisi termiche
• Preparano campioni, valutano i risultati, interpretano i risultati e producono report scritti
• Essi sviluppano inoltre metodi fisici e supportano in modo indipendente le sottozone nei progetti di sviluppo Requisiti
• Laurea in ingegneria o scienze naturali, idealmente in ingegneria meccanica di processo, scienze alimentari o chimica fisica
• Metodo di analisi preciso e persistente
• Divertimento di lavorare insieme in una squadra
• Il pensiero analitico e l'interesse per le questioni tecniche e scientifiche

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de compte de vente - Wheat & Rye

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join our dynamic team as a Sales Account Manager and become a key player in shaping the future of the grain industry! In this role, you'll be driving the promotion and sales of Bühler's innovative Wheat and Rye equipment across the US territory. Your mission will be to craft and execute sales strategies, engage with both existing and potential clients, and uncover their unique needs to deliver tailored solutions. You'll spearhead the development of both existing and new business opportunities while gathering invaluable market insights. If you're passionate about sales and ready to take on exciting challenges, we want you to be part of our journey towards transforming the industry! Aufgaben:
• Direct sales, promoting and selling the Buhler equipment and related equipment in a defined geography
• Develop and implement a sales plan for market and account coverage
• Prospecting, identifying new customers and working with existing owners to ensure that Buhler machinery is top of mind for all new projects
• Manages and maintains assigned accounts and key accounts
• Fosters customer relationships
• Develops and establishes new accounts
• Customer contact, collecting information, negotiating contracts
• Communicates and participates in solving problems related to customer orders or concerns
• Collects market data (customer and competition) that show the need of the businesses and industries within the territory
• Generating enquiries, filling out internal RFQ's and presenting quotes and proposals to the customer
• Close sales to meet or exceed a sales quota
• Attend trade shows as required, attend customer FATs, and travel to Europe as required
• Attend trainings in Europe as needed
• File customer contact reports, call reports and other pertinent information in a CRM
• Other duties as assigned Anforderungen:
• Bachelors Degree in Business, Engineering or equivalent
• Background in Food/Agriculture industry strongly preferred
• Strong mechanical/technical acumen desired
• 5+ years selling capital goods to the food industry
• Attention to detail
• Excellent organization, interpersonal communication skills and relationship building skills to effectively work with a variety of people and personalities; able to communicate clearly and effectively in person and in writing internally and externally
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
• Strong market and commercial awareness
• Ability to build relationships internally and externally while working across time zones and cultures
• A sales leader who can inspire others
• Experience in key account management and directing key account sales teams
• Interpersonal - considers the needs and feelings of others and appropriately responds to different situations
• Maintains discipline, recommending and administering corrective action according to company policy and procedures
• Advanced MS Office skills: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
• Oral and Written Communication - presents information, analysis, and ideas in writing in a clear and concise manner; speaks clearly so that others can hear and understand what is being said
• Speaks and understands English, German and/or Spanish a plus
• Domestic and international travel 65% of time which may include long hours and non-traditional work schedules Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Define system requirements and develop complete system solution on time, within budget, and in line with Bühler's quality, design, and EHS standards. The aim is to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction and risk mitigation. A System Engineer further details the functional requirements set by the process engineer and serves as the contact for other Bühler engineering disciplines and elaborate base for automation. The systems engineer “build the bridge” between the functional (Process, HW engineering) and the physical design (3D design and Installation Engineering). Aufgaben:
• Review the work package to ensure it meets process requirements and scope, identify deviations and risks, and propose mitigation actions.
• Help prepare project deliverables and estimate the needed engineering hours for the needed activities.
• Ensure that all interfaces with other engineering disciplines are coordinated in line with the assigned work package and establish effective interdisciplinary communication.
• Set up Site Structure with the plant, Line, Area and Function Groups. Define the necessary request objects on unit and sub-unit level.
• Defining Real Devices for all the objects within the Site structure incl. Location Structure, Customer Description and link to PCE Requests.
• Responsible for the definition and quality of all necessary attributes and data for the hand over to the automation department of small to medium plants. (E.g. Emergency System specification, safety relevant indication, pre-wiring information, interlocks)
• Ensure compliance with process requirements and maintain sizing calculations and functional requirements for specifying third-party equipment and piping.
• Visualize the data with different level of degree on PFD and PIDs according Bühler standards.
• Ensure that the arrangement and the piping routing correspond to the process requirements.
• Resolve questions or problems that occur during the design and manufacturing as well as during installation and commissioning and prepare as-built documentation.
• Record any project deviations, technical issues and product improvements in the Bühler CAQ system or via ticket to service desk.
• Capture return of experience and best practice, apply lessons learned to all templates Anforderungen:

• Know-how di base nello strumento CAD
• Comprensione dei principi di fabbricazione
• Buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e orali
• Buone capacità interpersonali e di lavoro di squadra
• Buone capacità di problem solving

descriptionByLocale.it:
Aufgaben:
• Prepare control philosophy document and obtain line manager approval prior to initiating software design.
• Create the software design and secure line manager approval before commencing PLC and Plant Control System (PCS) engineering.
• Prepare required PLC and PCS development tools and document, such as templates and simulators.
• Develop and simulate PLC and PCS software in alignment with project scope and customer requirements. Obtain line manager approval prior to the Customer Acceptance Test (CAT).
• Lead the CAT prior to commissioning. Present the software to the customer, ensure alignment between Bühler and the customer on the scope of work. Document and resolve all open points. Follow up with the customer as needed.
• Commission the PLC and PCS software in accordance with the scope of work and agreements reached during CAT. Submit commissioning reports to project team in timely manner and according to Bühler template.
• Conduct on-site training to the customer's team on Bühler PCS operations.
• Participate in project meetings to align with the project team and the customer from project initiation through completion.
• Store and backup all documentation and software properly.
• Securely store sensitive information, including customer passwords and internal documents in compliance with Bühler standards.
• Complete all deliverables (concept, engineering, commissioning) on time and within the approved project budget and timeline.
• Provide remote support for automation-related issues after commissioning, as required.
• Gather feedback and lesson learned during project execution and share with colleagues to drive continuous improvement Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering or any related Engineering degree
• At least 3 years of experience in automation design, implementation, or commissioning

descriptionByLocale.it:
Prendere un ruolo chiave nella formazione globale di Bühler Finance & Controling. Come proprietario di prodotti esperto, si guida processo e progettazione di soluzioni su SAP S/4HANA, che agisce come il integratore tra Finance & Controling e i nostri team aguzza. Migliorate continuamente le funzionalità e spingete il nostro panorama Finance & Controling verso l'eccellenza. Aufgaben:
• Guidate come parte del team globale di agile, lo sviluppo di soluzioni end-to-end per la contabilità, il controllo, il Tesoro, la fiscalità e la gestione dei viaggi
• assicurate la consegna continua del valore in una configurazione SAFe, con OKR chiari e risultati misurabili
• possiedi, affina e prioritize il Backlog del Team, eseguite la pianificazione e la revisione di Sprint, preparate e contribuite a PI Plannings e Demo di sistema
• collaborate con gli stakeholder per perfezionare i requisiti e progettare soluzioni di valore aggiunto per Bühler garantendo al contempo linee guida IT soprattutto in materia di conformità, sicurezza, continuità
• Gestite la Liscio passaggio e interfaccia in corso tra sviluppo e operazioni soluzioni Anforderungen:
• Hai una laurea in Informatica, Business Informatica, Business Administration, o un campo correlato
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza come Titolare del Prodotto, preferibile in ambiente SAFE o un'esperienza di leadership laterale comparabile
• Hai un background in Finanza con esperienza in SAP S/4 Hana (FI/CO) e alta affinità per la progettazione di processi e la creazione di esperienza utente
• Hai familiarità con eventi chiave able (ad esempio, Sprint Planning, PI Planning, System Demos) e idealmente tenere certificazioni come SAFE POPM, PSPO o CSPO
• Lei comunica chiaramente in inglese e tedesco e sa come mobilitare e allineare gli stakeholder senza autorità formale Wirbiet: VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero a partire da 9, 00 CHF. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, mentre sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Take a key role in shaping Bühler's global Finance & Controlling. As an experienced Product Owner, you drive process and solution design on SAP S/4HANA, acting as integrator between Finance & Controlling and our agile teams. You continuously improve functionalities and push our Finance & Controlling landscape toward excellence. Aufgaben:
• You drive as part of the global agile team, the development of end-to-end solutions for Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax, and Travel Management
• You ensure continuous value delivery in a SAFe setup, with clear OKRs and measurable outcomes
• You own, refine and prioritize the Team Backlog, run Sprint Planning and Reviews, prepare and contribute to PI Plannings and System Demos
• You collaborate with stakeholders to refine requirements and design value-adding solutions for Bühler while ensuring IT guidelines especially around compliance, security, continuity
• You manage the smooth handover and ongoing interface between solution development and operations Anforderungen:
• You hold a degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Business Administration, or a related field
• You bring several years of experience as a Product Owner, preferable in SAFe environment or comparable lateral leadership experience
• You have a background in Finance with experience in SAP S/4 Hana (FI/CO) and high affinity for designing processes and creating user experience
• You are familiar with key agile events (e.g., Sprint Planning, PI Planning, System Demos) and ideally hold certifications such as SAFe POPM, PSPO, or CSPO
• You communicate clearly in English and German and know how to mobilize and align stakeholders without formal authority Wir bieten: VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. As a Global Customs Advisor at our headquarters in Uzwil, you will support both our local business units and our global subsidiaries as a key partner in customs clearance, compliance, and process optimization. With your expertise, you will drive the design of import and export processes, support the determination of origin of goods, and advise on a wide range of foreign trade matters. This is an exciting opportunity to take on a role with international reach and real business impact. Aufgaben:
• You serve as the Global Customs Advisor and provide expert guidance on import/export processes, origin of goods, and other foreign trade-related matters
• You advise and actively support our business units in Uzwil and global subsidiaries on customs clearance, optimization, and origin-related questions
• You represent foreign trade topics in internal Group projects, drive process, data, and IT improvements, and support SAP GTS rollouts across Group locations
• You monitor regional and global foreign trade developments, assess their impact on supply chains and competitiveness, and derive relevant actions
• You independently manage customs and origin checks, deliver training sessions, and act as the central point of contact for authorities and associations Anforderungen:

• Service-oriented, resilient, and committed personality with strong communication skills and the ability to interact confidently with internal and external stakeholders in a global environment

Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui permettent de libérer des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) besticht durch Engagement und Zuverlässigkeit und scheut sich nicht davor eigenständig Aufgaben zu übernehmen.

• Formazione professionale completata come miller o qualifica equivalente, idealmente combinata con una formazione tecnica avanzata nella fresatura (ad es. Scuola Svizzera di fresatura, DMSB, o simili), oltre a diversi anni di esperienza pratica nel settore della macinazione
• Profonda esperienza tecnica in grano, duro, avena e mais, compresa una conoscenza dettagliata di macchinari, aspirazione e pneumatica, completata da una conoscenza di base della tecnologia elettrica e dell'automazione
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale per ispezioni di mulino, formazione dei clienti e supporto in loco, combinata con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in diverse culture e ambienti
• Indipendente, responsabile e motivante personalità con forte forza abilità di lavoro di gruppo, la capacità di rimanere calmi sotto pressione, e una presenza sicura e professionale quando rappresenta l'azienda esternamente
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in arabo, francese e inglese, sia scritto e parlato; lingue aggiuntive come il tedesco o lo spagnolo sono un vantaggio Wirbiet: Attraente diritto di vacanza Abbastanza tempo per rilassarsi e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + travelcard a metà prezzo per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente biglietto da viaggio di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero a partire da 9, 00 CHF.Piano pensionistico finanziato dai datori di lavoro Il Fondo Pensioni Bühler offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensionistico indipendente che garantisce sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch Abbonamenti per cellulari Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti per cellulari via Mobilezone con Sunrise e Swisscom. Attività sportive Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione auto-organizzata del circuito e gruppi di corsa così come i buoni per l'aggiornamento e la Fitness Activ. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, mentre sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Milling Solutions is the leading specialist in state-of-the-art process technologies for producing high-quality flour and semolina products from wheat, durum, rye, and corn. To strengthen our team in the Milling Academy, we are looking for a committed, entrepreneurial-minded personality as Instructor Process Technology. Aufgaben:
• You train customer personnel and internal employees in milling technology, both at the Milling Academy and on-site through hands-on training
• You create, update, and maintain training materials and course documentation, while continuously familiarizing yourself with new technologies and equipment
• You define and further develop course content together with the team to ensure high-quality and up-to-date training programs
• You support customers and course participants by providing professional guidance, organizing visits and representations, and ensuring a positive overall training experience
• You provide technological and administrative support to the Customer Service and Technology departments, including sales-supporting activities such as mill inspections and technical assistance in discussions Anforderungen:
• Completed vocational training as a miller or an equivalent qualification, ideally combined with advanced technical education in milling (e.g. Swiss School of Milling, DMSB, or similar), as well as several years of practical experience in the milling industry
• Profound technical expertise in wheat, durum, oat, and corn milling, including detailed knowledge of machinery, aspiration, and pneumatics, complemented by a basic understanding of electrical and automation technology
• Willingness to travel internationally for mill inspections, customer training, and on-site support, combined with the ability to work effectively across different cultures and environments
• Independent, responsible, and motivating personality with strong teamwork skills, the ability to stay calm under pressure, and a confident and professional presence when representing the company externally
• Strong communication skills in Arabic, French and English, both written and spoken; additional languages such as German or Spanish are an advantage Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Mobile phone subscriptions We offer special conditions for cell phone subscriptions via Mobilezone with Sunrise and Swisscom. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando un Product Manager per guidare lo sviluppo, la redditività e il successo a lungo termine del portafoglio di servizi e lavorazione del cioccolato di Bühler. Il ruolo è fondamentale per definire la strategia del portafoglio, tradurre le esigenze del mercato e dei clienti in soluzioni innovative e garantire una crescita sostenibile del business. Lavorerete a stretto contatto con clienti, vendite, servizi, ricerca e sviluppo, ingegneria e operazioni per rafforzare la leadership del mercato di Bühler nella lavorazione del cioccolato. Aufgaben:
• Guidate la strategia e la crescita del portafoglio definendo la roadmap, individuando le opportunità di mercato e garantendo la competitività a lungo termine del portafoglio prodotti e servizi
• Gestite l'intero ciclo di vita dei prodotti e servizi attraverso nuove introduzioni di prodotti, ottimizzazione del portafoglio, iniziative di standardizzazione, sviluppo di servizi e attività di eliminazione graduale
• Traducete le esigenze del cliente e del mercato in soluzioni raccogliendo informazioni di mercato, analizzando le tendenze del settore, le esigenze dei clienti e gli sviluppi competitivi
• Supportate il successo commerciale definendo proposizioni di valore, strategie di prezzo, casi aziendali e piani di commercializzazione per prodotti e servizi
• Crea e guida contenuti di vendita e marketing definendo messaggi chiave, supportando campagne, consentendo team di vendita con strumenti e formazione efficaci, nonché rappresentando Bühler ad eventi interni ed esterni Anforderungen:
• Laurea presso un'Università o un'Università di Scienze Applicate (FH) in Ingegneria, Tecnologia alimentare o Amministrazione aziendale
• Diversi anni di esperienza in Gestione dei prodotti, Sviluppo commerciale, vendite, o un ruolo strategico comparabile, nonché esperienza in gestione del portafoglio, prezzi, lanci di prodotti, analisi di mercato e attività di commercializzazione
• Forte acumen aziendale combinato con affinità tecnica e la capacità di tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in opportunità di business redditizie
• Ottime competenze di comunicazione in inglese, combinata con eccellenti competenze di gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di influenzare attraverso funzioni, regioni e culture
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale (circa il 20,30%) Wirbiet: VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo una carta di credito per i trasporti pubblici OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + mezza tariffa per CHF 365 + CHF 400 e una carta di viaggio di prima classe attraente o parcheggio gratuito.Piano pensionistico finanziato dai datori di lavoro Il fondo pensione Bühler offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce sicurezza finanziaria affidabile nel pensionamento: www.pk-buhler.ch Attrazione per il diritto alla vacanza Abbastanza tempo per rilassarsi e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età. Salute-Porto Ci impegniamo a prevenire la salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, trucchi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Abbonamenti telefonici Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti cellulari via Mobilezone con Sunrise e Swisscom. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con le attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli i cui pezzi sono stati fabbricati con le nostre macchine. Bühler punta a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sblocchino opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a Product Manager to drive the development, profitability, and long-term success of Bühler's chocolate processing and service portfolio. The role is critical in shaping portfolio strategy, translating market and customer needs into innovative solutions, and ensuring sustainable business growth. You will work closely with customers, sales, service, R&D, engineering, and operations to strengthen Bühler's market leadership in chocolate processing. Aufgaben:
• You drive portfolio strategy and growth by defining the roadmap, identifying market opportunities, and ensuring the long-term competitiveness of the product and service portfolio
• You manage the full lifecycle of products and services by leading new product introductions, portfolio optimization, standardization initiatives, service development, and phase-out activities
• You translate customer and market needs into solutions by gathering market insights, analyzing industry trends, customer requirements, and competitive developments
• You support commercial success by defining value propositions, pricing strategies, business cases, and commercialization plans for products and services
• You create and steer sales and marketing content by defining key messaging, supporting campaigns, and enabling sales teams with effective tools and training as well as representing Bühler at internal and external events Anforderungen:
• Degree from a University or University of Applied Sciences (FH) in Engineering, Food Technology or Business Administration
• Several years of experience in Product Management, Business Development, Sales, or a comparable strategic role as well as experience in portfolio management, pricing, product launches, market analysis, and commercialization activities
• Strong business acumen combined with technical affinity and the ability to translate customer needs into profitable business opportunities
• Very good communication skills in English combined with excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across functions, regions, and cultures
• Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 20–30%) Wir bieten: VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Health-Port We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Mobile phone subscriptions We offer special conditions for cell phone subscriptions via Mobilezone with Sunrise and Swisscom. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Wir suchen einen Produktmanager, der die Entwicklung, Rentabilität und den langfristigen Erfolg des Schokoladen- und Serviceportfolios von Bühler vorantreibt. Entscheidend ist die Entwicklung der Portfoliostrategie, die Umsetzung der Markt- und Kundenbedürfnisse in innovative Lösungen und die Gewährleistung eines nachhaltigen Unternehmenswachstums. Sie arbeiten eng mit Kunden, Vertrieb, Service, Forschung und Entwicklung, Engineering und Operationen zusammen, um Bühlers Marktführerschaft in der Schokoladenverarbeitung zu stärken.
• Sie fördern die Portfoliostrategie und das Wachstum, indem Sie die Roadmap definieren, Marktchancen identifizieren und die langfristige Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Produkt- und Dienstleistungsportfolios sicherstellen
• Sie verwalten den gesamten Lebenszyklus von Produkten und Dienstleistungen durch führende neue Produkteinführungen, Portfoliooptimierungen, Normungsinitiativen, Dienstleistungsentwicklungen und Ausstiegsaktivitäten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous recherchons un Product Manager pour stimuler le développement, la rentabilité et le succès à long terme du portefeuille de traitement et de service de chocolat de Bühler. Le rôle est essentiel pour façonner la stratégie de portefeuille, traduire les besoins du marché et du client en solutions innovantes et assurer une croissance durable des entreprises. Aufgaben:
• Vous pilotez la stratégie et la croissance du portefeuille en définissant la feuille de route, en identifiant les opportunités du marché et en assurant la compétitivité à long terme du portefeuille de produits et services
• Vous gérez le cycle de vie complet des produits et services en dirigeant de nouvelles introductions de produits, l'optimisation du portefeuille, des initiatives de normalisation, le développement de services et des activités d'élimination progressive
• Vous traduisez les besoins du client et du marché en solutions en recueillant des idées sur le marché, en analysant les tendances de l'industrie, les besoins des clients et les développements concurrentiels
• Vous soutenez la réussite commerciale en définissant
• Vous créez et dirigez des contenus commerciaux et marketing en définissant des messages clés, en soutenant des campagnes et en permettant aux équipes de vente d'utiliser des outils et une formation efficaces ainsi que de représenter Bühler lors d'événements internes et externes. expérience dans la gestion de portefeuille, la tarification, le lancement de produits, l'analyse de marché et les activités de commercialisation
• Forte acuité des affaires, alliée à l'affinité technique et à la capacité de traduire les besoins des clients en opportunités commerciales rentables
• Très bonne capacité de communication en anglais, combinée à d'excellentes compétences de gestion des parties prenantes avec la capacité d'influencer les fonctions, les régions et les cultures
• Volonté de voyager à l'international (environ 20-30%) Wir bieten: VIVA Restaurant Nous offrons à nos employés un menu de fitness quotidien à partir de 9,00 CHF. Concept de mobilité attractive Nous offrons une carte de voyage ZVV / Z-Pass + demi-tarif pour CHF 365 + CHF 400 crédit de transport public ainsi qu'une carte de voyage de première classe attrayante ou un parking gratuit.Plan de retraite financé par l'employeur La Caisse de retraite Bühler offre aux salariés Bühler une caisse de retraite indépendante qui assure une sécurité financière fiable à la retraite : www.pk-buhler.ch Attractive vacation right Assez de temps pour se détendre et les intérêts personnels - nous offrons de 25 à 30 jours de vacances par an selon l'âge. Santé-Port Nous nous engageons dans les soins de santé préventifs par des analyses de laboratoire, des massages, des conseils nutritionnels, des cours de physiothérapie, des cours de groupe et un médecin d'entreprise. Abonnements de téléphonie mobile Nous offrons des conditions spéciales pour les abonnements de téléphonie cellulaire via Mobilezone avec Sunrise et Swisscom. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments qui ont été produits avec l'équipement Bühler. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui permettent de libérer des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Offer in-depth technical guidance and direction within the area of expertise. Serve as the primary contact for situations requiring advanced technical knowledge. Act as a representative for the company with external stakeholders, embodying the firm's commitment to technical excellence and professional integrity. Aufgaben:
• Participate in technical reviews (e.g. design reviews) as a technical authority – approve and reject technical solutions
• Actively participate in project meetings with cross - functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers
• Drive innovative and reliable designs from technology development until customer satisfaction in his field of specialization
• Train and coach Team Members inside and across in his field of specialization
• Perform knowledge management and maintain an expertise networks by documenting the expertise
• Liaise with the Project Management Office to establish, implement and maintain operating standards to ensure quality project results and customer satisfaction Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, or equivalent
• Minimum 10 years of experience in the industry, including experience in his field of specialization
• Insightful, able to collaborate with other management team members in developing strategy and implementing business plans
• Proven ability to work in a matrix organization
• Advanced know-how in 3D CAD tool, preferably with plant layout design experience
• Proficiency in English language Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a student looking to turn your theoretical knowledge into practical experience? Would you like to contribute to the entire employee lifecycle, HR administration, and training tools that make a real difference? Then you might be our new Student Assistant in the HR team at Bühler. Aufgaben: As a Student Assistant, you will support a variety of administrative tasks across HR. Your responsibilities may include supporting HR administration, assisting with coordination activities, helping maintain HR documentation, and contributing to different HR processes and projects. You will have the opportunity to work with HR administration throughout the entire employee lifecycle, including updating employee data in our HR systems such as SAP, workforce and SuccessFactors, handling master data, absence, and time registration, as well as preparing and maintaining HR documentation. This role gives you the opportunity to apply your knowledge, strengthen your administrative skills, and gain practical experience in an international company where safety and collaboration are key priorities. Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der führenden Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Group in Lagos, Nigeria is looking for a skilled professional to join our team as Sales Channel Manager. This role will focus on driving sustainable business growth across Ghana, Liberia, Nigeria, Sierra Leone, and The Gambia by developing and managing Bühler's channel partner and reseller network. This position will also be responsible for increasing market share, while ensuring strong alignment with Bühler's regional and global strategies. Aufgaben:
• Drive market share growth and profitable business expansion in alignment with Bühler's group and regional strategic plans.
• Identify, evaluate, and develop new business opportunities, including emerging markets, customer segments, and distribution channels.
• Strengthen Bühler's market presence in Nigeria by expanding and optimizing partner, reseller, and distribution networks.
• Develop, manage, and grow channel partner relationships, ensuring partners are effectively onboarded, enabled, and aligned with Bühler's standards and business objectives.
• Monitor partner performance and act as the key interface between external partners and internal stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and business delivery.
• Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and opportunity development to proposal submission, negotiation, and order intake.
• Maintain a transparent and accurate sales pipeline, including CRM updates, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and timely follow-up on leads.
• Drive project and plant sales initiatives in collaboration with internal teams such as Sales Support, Technology, and Service to ensure successful project execution.
• Execute business strategies within the assigned territory, collaborating with regional and global teams to achieve defined sales and growth targets. Anforderungen:
• Minimum 5 years of experience in project sales and/or machine sales
• Experience working in a global or matrix organization
• Proven track record in channel partner or reseller management
• Strong market knowledge of Nigeria and/or Africa Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. B. Hubgeräte, Frontstapler oder Gabelstapler) • Durchführung von Bestands- und Qualitätskontrollen • Kommissionierung und termingerechte Bereitstellung bzw. B. Lagerverwaltungssysteme) • Staplerschein von Vorteil • Hohe Zuverlässigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise • Teamfähigkeit, Einsatzbereitschaft sowie eine hohe Ausdauer und Konzentrationsfähigkeit Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg.
